about: Answers of the last `leadership eval --chat`, for the manual citation review.

robinhood.com.question: Who is the CEO?
robinhood.com.answer: Vladimir Tenev is the Chair and Chief Executive Officer of Robinhood, according to a SEC filing dated 2026‑04‑22: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000053/hood-20260422.htm.
sql: SELECT person, title, source_url, source_date, source_type FROM current_leadership WHERE canonical_role = 'CEO'

robinhood.com.question: Who are the current C-level executives?
robinhood.com.answer:
The current C‑level team at Robinhood (as of the latest public filings) includes:

- **Vladimir Tenev** – Chair and Chief Executive Officer (SEC filing, 2026‑04‑22) ; also listed as President (SEC filing, 2026‑02‑18).  
- **Daniel Gallagher** – Chief Legal Officer (SEC filing, 2026‑04‑22) ; also titled Chief Legal, Compliance, and Corporate Affairs Officer (same source).  
- **Dara Bazzano** – Chief Accounting Officer (SEC filing, 2026‑06‑26).  
- **Shiv Verma** – Chief Financial Officer (SEC filing, 2026‑06‑26).  
- **Steven Quirk** – Chief Brokerage Officer (SEC filing, 2026‑04‑22).  

These five individuals are the C‑level executives recorded in the current leadership data.

Sources:
- Daniel Gallagher: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000053/hood-20260422.htm (sec_filing, 2026-04-22)
- Dara Bazzano: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000083/hood-20260625.htm (sec_filing, 2026-06-26)
- Shiv Verma: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000083/hood-20260625.htm (sec_filing, 2026-06-26)
- Steven Quirk: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000053/hood-20260422.htm (sec_filing, 2026-04-22)
- Vladimir Tenev: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000053/hood-20260422.htm (sec_filing, 2026-04-22)
sql: SELECT person, title, source_url, source_date, source_type FROM current_leadership WHERE level = 'c_level' ORDER BY person

robinhood.com.question: How many C-level executives were found?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) AS count FROM current_leadership WHERE level = 'c_level';

robinhood.com.question: Who was the previous CFO?
robinhood.com.answer: The previous CFO was Jason Warnick, who ceased to serve as Chief Financial Officer effective 2026-02-06 and has left the role; according to a SEC filing, 2026-04-22: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000053/hood-20260422.htm
sql: SELECT person, title, status, employment_status, ended_on, end_reported_on, ended_by_source_url, ended_by_source_date, ended_by_evidence, source_url, source_date, source_type FROM leadership WHERE company_domain = 'robinhood.com' AND canonical_role = 'CFO' ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='former' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(ended_on, end_reported_on, last_seen) DESC LIMIT 10;

robinhood.com.question: Is Jeffrey Pinner still the CTO?
robinhood.com.answer: No. Jeffrey Pinner is no longer CTO. The role is marked former and ended on 2026-05-07, according to the sec_filing, 2026-05-08: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000065/hood-20260507.htm. The role row itself was sourced from the sec_filing, 2026-04-22: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000053/hood-20260422.htm.
sql: SELECT person, title, status, employment_status, canonical_role, source_type, source_date, source_url, evidence, ended_on, end_reported_on, ended_by_source_url, ended_by_source_date FROM leadership WHERE company_domain = 'robinhood.com' AND person LIKE 'Jeffrey Pinner%' AND (canonical_role = 'CTO' OR title LIKE '%CTO%' OR title LIKE '%Chief Technology Officer%') ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'current' THEN 1 WHEN 'former' THEN 2 WHEN 'unverified' THEN 3 WHEN 'announced' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, last_seen DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT person, title, status, employment_status, ended_on, end_reported_on, ended_by_source_url, ended_by_source_date, source_url, source_date FROM leadership WHERE person = 'Jeffrey Pinner'
corrected: Jeffrey Pinner: the end of the role is cited to https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000053/hood-20260422.htm, which is not a source showing it ended; cite ended_by_source_url (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000065/hood-20260507.htm)

robinhood.com.question: Is Jason Warnick still at Robinhood?
robinhood.com.answer:
Jason Warnick is no longer at Robinhood. The collected data shows him as former, with employment_status also former.

For his advisory role, the role is former and ended on 2026-09-01; the role held is supported by https://fortune.com/2025/12/29/who-is-robinhoods-cfo-shiv-verma-transition, 2025-12-29, and the end of the role is supported by https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000013/hood-20260206.htm, 2026-02-10.

For his Chief Financial Officer role, the role is former and ended on 2026-02-06; the role held is supported by https://robinhood.com/newsroom/christina-smedley-joins-robinhood-as-chief-marketing-officer, 2020-08-04, and the end of the role is supported by https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000053/hood-20260422.htm, 2026-04-22.
sql: SELECT person, title, employment_status, status, ended_on, end_reported_on, source_type, source_date, source_url, evidence FROM leadership WHERE company_domain = 'robinhood.com' AND person = 'Jason Warnick' ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='current' THEN 0 WHEN status='former' THEN 1 WHEN status='unverified' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, COALESCE(ended_on, end_reported_on, last_seen) DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT person, title, status, employment_status, ended_on, end_reported_on, ended_by_source_url, ended_by_source_date, source_url, source_date FROM leadership WHERE person = 'Jason Warnick' ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='current' THEN 0 WHEN status='former' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, COALESCE(ended_on, end_reported_on, last_seen) DESC LIMIT 10;
corrected: Jason Warnick: the end of the role is cited to https://fortune.com/2025/12/29/who-is-robinhoods-cfo-shiv-verma-transition, which is not a source showing it ended; cite ended_by_source_url (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000013/hood-20260206.htm, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387926000053/hood-20260422.htm)
